question: How much of the fixed p_X=1/10 IID channel is covered by the four existing complete first records, and what minimum prior mass remains in other first-charge records of the selected flux and in other first-flux sectors?

hypotheses.selected_flux_coverage: The four exact records capture nearly all prior mass within their selected first-flux sector, with a bounded residual first-charge tail.
hypotheses.selected_flux_gap: Other first-charge records retain material selected-flux prior mass despite the four small conditional omitted-error bounds.
hypotheses.full_channel_gap: The selected first-flux sector itself holds only a small part of the normalized 36-edge IID prior, so four-record conditional results cannot represent the full channel.

frozen_model: R6AF ideal periodic L=2 D4 orbit, 36 IID red-X physical edges at p_X=1/10 and p_Z=0, J6O complete full-binary public first record with vacuum=1-charge. Four disjoint J8L corrected first records share one selected J8J flux sector. J8M supplies rigorous one-site omitted joint-mass upper bounds. The two fixed relation-free public actions and private generation/scoring boundary are unchanged, but no second law or policy is evaluated here.

branches: Sum four disjoint first-record exact known joint masses and omitted upper bounds to form a rigorous coverage interval within the selected first-flux sector; subtract from exact selected-flux prior to bound all other first-charge records there.
Use exact 36-edge IID normalization and J8J selected-flux prior to calculate the complementary prior mass in all other first-flux sectors; do not enumerate their public laws.
matrix.independent_unit: One disjoint complete public first-record event or its complementary flux sector; exact rational arithmetic, no stochastic uncertainty.
matrix.integrity: Pin all three accepted input results and runner; verify 36-edge IID binomial normalization, rank 23/nullity 13, four distinct corrected 24-bit public records with common flux, J8L known mass and J8M omitted upper-bound consistency, interval partition identities and hash stability. Fail closed on any mismatch.

acceptance: Exact prior-mass interval for four complete first records and complement among other first-charge records in selected flux
Exact selected versus other first-flux prior-mass partition over the normalized IID physical channel
Explicit prohibition on full-IID information/risk inference from this mass-coverage audit
stop_rule: Stop after the two exact arithmetic branches or first integrity/CPU failure. Do not evaluate any additional first or second law, fit a threshold, broaden size/rate grid, or convert coverage into an information theorem.
